en.p: In the coordinate plane, two points $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ on the circle whose diameter is segment $\mathrm{AB}$ of length $10\sqrt{2}$ satisfy

When $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PB}}\right|=14$, $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PA}}\cdot\overrightarrow{\mathrm{QB}}\right|=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Given that $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{QB}}\right|>0$, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
